meta.rule: A source may only be cited for a value that was actually read on the access date. Tier A = primary government/regulatory record. Tier B = issuer filing with a securities regulator (SEC). Tier C = official company/agency disclosure that is not a regulator filing. Tier D = secondary/industry commentary; never used for a published value in this workbook.

tiers.A: Primary official government or regulatory record
tiers.B: Primary issuer filing with a securities regulator (SEC EDGAR / XBRL)
tiers.C: Official agency disclosure not filed with a regulator
tiers.D: Secondary or industry commentary - not used for any published value
